model.scope: Original solid-black grayscale JPEG controls only; no universal codec or arbitrary-color interpolation conclusion.
model.heldout_scope: The reversed/shifted 100% grid was declared before first model observation; the exact-integer grid was generated after the first phase results to distinguish ceil from floor+1, before viewing its frames.

failures.description: Initial rectangle reproduction failed exact-file equality. The 39,515-byte PDFs differed at 62 byte positions confined to the one trailer /ID record. Original captures and outputs were retained. Final helpers use deterministic_id=True; all 43 diagnostic outputs reproduce every byte except the observed trailer ID, and 10 deterministic repeat outputs are byte-exact. This is not an exact-original-file reproduction claim.

limitations: The 132-axis rule is measured on original uniform-black grayscale JPEG controls only. It does not identify an internal API or establish arbitrary-color resampling or other codecs.

Reversed/shifted views were declared before model observation; integer controls were designed after phase-one results and before their own observations. These are phased controls, not a fully blinded 132-axis discovery set.
Target-zoom matrices deliberately change physical geometry. Cross-zoom regressions rule out adopting them as a general fixed PDF correction.
All nine actual-document target-zoom views still differ; remaining grayscale/interpolation and text-raster differences are unresolved.
There is no new production conversion, runtime parity or whole-77-page visual sweep in this study. The current production cohort still differs on all 77 pages.

No source documents, generated PDFs, screenshots or font binaries are committed. No original font program, image payload, semantic text operator or nonimage operator is changed by the device-grid diagnostic.
Closed #534 completed its explicit unresolved-classification scope; it did not resolve these rendering differences. #543 and parent #406 remain implementation obligations.
